name: Dryad
notes: CR 1. Fey Charm (DC 14 WIS). Innate spellcasting CHA. Tree Stride.
gm_notes: Session 4. Sacred grove spirit; optional combat if the party disrespects the grove or attacks first. Fey Charm can neutralize a threat without bloodshed if the DM wants to de-escalate. Tree Stride lets it withdraw and reposition between trees.
